title: Ordinary multiple points and their coordinate-axes algebras
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] over $k$ with structure map $p$, and let $x\in X$. For $n\geq0$, define $R_n=k[[T_1,\ldots,T_n]]/(T_iT_j\mid i\ne j)$ using [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. The point $x$ is a (split) ordinary $n$-fold point if $n\geq1$ and the maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is isomorphic to $R_n$ compatibly with the structural scalar map $k\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ (the map of [def-trf-orgogozo-induction-data]). Thus the isomorphism is one of $k$-algebras. The one-axis case is included.
